WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
shares AS (
  SELECT order_id, invoice_count,
         1.0 * invoice_count / (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) FROM order_counts) AS share
  FROM order_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares
),
above AS (
  SELECT s.invoice_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS excess
  FROM shares s, avg_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
)
SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess) AS average_excess
FROM above;
